entries.label: Dog
entries.description: A dog travelling with its owner. Assistance animals are covered by law, not by this list.

osm.note: When the species is allowed on_leash.

entries.label: Cat
entries.description: A cat travelling with its owner. Many sites and parks that allow dogs do not allow cats, because cats hunt wildlife.

osm.note: Documented on Key:cat as in use.

entries.label: Horse
entries.description: A horse brought to the site, usually in a horse float, as at horse camps in parks and state forests.

osm.note: Key:horse is access for riders on a way or area, not whether horses may stay.
